description: This file defines the ModelReport class, which provides functionality to generate diagnostic reports, visualizations, and configuration mappings related to quantization issues in PyTorch FX GraphModules. It incorporates detectors for various quantization concerns, manages observer insertion/removal, and produces summaries and visualizations for model analysis.

classes.name: ModelReport
classes.description: A class providing mechanisms to generate diagnostic reports on quantization configurations, visualize results, and produce recommended quantization and equalization configurations for traced FX GraphModules in PyTorch.

methods.name: __init__(self, model: GraphModule, desired_report_detectors: set[DetectorBase])
methods.description: Initializes the ModelReport with a GraphModule and a set of detectors for generating various quantization reports.

methods.name: set[str] get_desired_reports_names(self)
methods.description: Returns a copy of the set of desired report detector names.

methods.name: dict[str,set[str]] get_observers_of_interest(self)
methods.description: Returns a copy of the mapping from detector names to observer fully qualified names.

methods.name: GraphModule prepare_detailed_calibration(self)
methods.description: Inserts observers into the model at specified points based on detectors to prepare for calibration.

methods.name: _insert_observer_around_module( self, obs_fqn: str, target_node: torch.fx.node.Node, obs_to_insert: ObserverBase, observer_args: tuple, insert_post: bool, )
methods.description: Helper to insert an observer module around a target node in the FX graph.

methods.name: torch.fx.node.Node _get_node_from_fqn(self, node_fqn: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific node from the FX graph given its fully qualified name.

methods.name: dict[str,tuple[str,dict]] generate_model_report( self, remove_inserted_observers: bool )
methods.description: Generates individual detector reports after calibration, optionally removes observers, and returns the compiled reports.

methods.name: bool _is_same_info_for_same_key(self, info_dict_a: dict, info_dict_b: dict)
methods.description: Checks if shared keys in two info dictionaries have identical values, handling tensors appropriately.

methods.name: OrderedDict _reformat_reports_for_visualizer(self)
methods.description: Reformats generated reports into a format suitable for visualization tools.

methods.name: ModelReportVisualizer generate_visualizer(self)
methods.description: Creates a ModelReportVisualizer instance based on the latest reports.

methods.name: QConfigMapping _generate_qconfig_mapping_helper( self, detector_qconfig_info_combined: dict[str, DetectorQConfigInfo], generation_function: Callable, )
methods.description: Helper to create a QConfigMapping from detector information and a generation function.

methods.name: _update_detector_quantizaiton_qconfig_info( self, combined_info: DetectorQConfigInfo, new_info: DetectorQConfigInfo )
methods.description: Merges two DetectorQConfigInfo objects for quantization configuration recommendations.

methods.name: _update_detector_equalization_qconfig_info( self, combined_info: DetectorQConfigInfo, new_info: DetectorQConfigInfo )
methods.description: Merges two DetectorQConfigInfo objects for equalization configuration recommendations.

methods.name: dict[str,DetectorQConfigInfo] _generate_module_fqn_to_detector_info_mapping( self, update_qconfig_info_function: Callable )
methods.description: Creates a combined mapping of module FQNs to DetectorQConfigInfo objects based on detectors' suggestions.

methods.name: QConfigMapping generate_qconfig_mapping(self)
methods.description: Generates a QConfigMapping based on detector recommendations.

methods.name: QConfig _quantization_config_generator( self, detector_qconfig_info: DetectorQConfigInfo, module: torch.nn.Module )
methods.description: Creates a QConfig from DetectorQConfigInfo for quantization setup.

methods.name: EqualizationQConfig _equalization_config_generator( self, detector_qconfig_info: DetectorQConfigInfo, module: torch.nn.Module )
methods.description: Creates an EqualizationQConfig from DetectorQConfigInfo for de/quantization setup.

methods.name: QConfigMapping generate_equalization_mapping(self)
methods.description: Generates an Equalization QConfigMapping based on detector suggestions for equalization.
